notes.title: "TIC-TAC: Twelve o'clock" When will the game be released?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39260154/755660cb69d4f72f6227a4c1af77ebe023b7a66f.jpg[/img]

Hello dear friends! 

We want to inform you that the release is planned for this year, We really hope that we can handle it, and we will no longer have to debug it.

Thanks to everyone who is waiting for the release of the game and is interested in how development is progressing.

Best wishes,
ARMAG team.

notes.title: Ukrainian Games Festival 2023 on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello dear friends,

We are happy to announce that TIC-TAC: Twelve o'clock will participate in the Ukrainian Games Festival 2023 on Steam, which runs from the 18th to the 24th of August.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/UkrainianGames2023]Click to visit the Festival page on Steam[/url]

Dive into the awesome Ukrainian games, and we hope you will get to play lots of great titles throughout the festival. August 24 is the Independence Day of Ukraine, which holds profound significance for every Ukrainian.


Best wishes,
ARMAG team.

notes.title: Release delay "TIC-TAC: Twelve o'clock".
notes.content:
Hello dear friends, 

We are developers from Ukraine, we have very difficult times in our country now. We try to work on the game for you as much as we can, we hope for your understanding and support, we try to release the game as soon as possible.

[u]Best wishes,
ARMAG team.[/u]

notes.content:
